initial.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Recreate the SAME adult female Valkyrie: long light golden hair, winged gold helmet with face visible, fitted gold-and-platinum plate armor, ivory/black split tabard, gold greaves, exactly FOUR translucent golden feather wings (two pairs), elegant golden LIGHT BOW. No red or purple armor, no extra limbs. Slight overhead 3/4 game camera, full body and all wing/bow tips entirely in each cell; keep helmet-to-boots body scale, face, costume and lighting consistent across every frame. Real transparent alpha, no background, no checkerboard, no title, words, labels, borders, grid, shadows or decorative ground. Warm gold light with readable bronze shadows; avoid white bloom obscuring armor or hands. Large transparent cell margins. EXACTLY 24 full-body sprites on a regular FOUR-COLUMN x SIX-ROW sheet, portrait 1536x2048. Every cell 384x341.33.
